rule: A strategy stays on the site when, in the backtest, its long-only account beat buying and holding the market and its buy alerts beat a random day after 20 sessions, without a losing live record. Commodities: nothing beat holding the S&P 500, so the three that made money with an edge stay. Top-Down Analysis stays as its own kind of tool. Everything else is in the Vault: no alerts or notifications, still tracked in the record and paper trades, still testable in the Strategy Lab. Notes: research/core-strategies.md.
